name: Lead Scorer
summary: Every morning, score new HubSpot leads using company size and recent activity, explain each score, and post the top 5 to Slack.

items.title: HubSpot lead reader
items.description: Reads newly added leads and their company size and activity data from HubSpot.
items.proved_when: New leads are successfully fetched from HubSpot.

items.title: Slack poster
items.description: Posts messages to the designated Slack channel.
items.proved_when: Messages appear in the specified Slack channel.

items.title: Lead scoring and explanation writer
items.description: Scores each new lead from 0 to 100 based on company size and recent activity, and explains the score.
items.proved_when: Generated scores and explanations are attached to each lead.
items.source_quote: score new HubSpot leads from 0 to 100 using company size and recent activity, explain each score

items.title: Morning schedule trigger
items.description: Triggers the lead scoring and posting process every morning.
items.proved_when: The process runs automatically at the scheduled morning time.

items.title: Lead score history
items.description: Stores scored leads and their explanations for reference.
items.proved_when: Scored leads are saved and viewable in the data table.
